description: Canonical Lofi Loop spec: visualizer overlay graphs and look presets. Served by manifoldgen.com at GET /api/lofi-loop/spec and vendored by lowfi-cli. Placeholders substituted by the renderer: {{in}} {{out}} {{w}} {{h}} {{vizh}} {{s}} {{rate}} {{alpha}} {{colors}} {{tint}}.

defaults.style: hand-painted lofi album cover illustration, thick gouache brushwork, soft film grain, muted limited palette, strong single light source, subtle paper texture, cinematic composition, no text, no watermark, no logo
defaults.negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, ui, frame, border, multiple panels, collage, deformed hands, extra fingers, blurry, jpeg artifacts

visualizers.label: Spectrum Bars
visualizers.desc: Log-frequency spectrum standing on the bottom edge, redrawn each frame so the loop closes.

visualizers.label: Waveform Line
visualizers.desc: A single soft waveform thread running across the lower third.

visualizers.label: Mirrored Wave
visualizers.desc: Waveform mirrored around the bottom edge, like a reflection on wet stone.

visualizers.label: Log Frequency Bars
visualizers.desc: Coarse log-spaced frequency bars rising from the bottom edge.

visualizers.label: Lissajous Orb
visualizers.desc: Glowing stereo vector orb suspended over the scene.

visualizers.label: Spectrogram Glow
visualizers.desc: Full-frame constant-Q spectrogram washed over the whole scene.

presets.label: Slow Drift
presets.desc: Wide lateral drift with a breath of brightness — calm, endless, the default lofi look.

presets.label: Breathe
presets.desc: Gentle push-in and pull-back on the cover art; nothing travels, everything breathes.

presets.label: Rain Window
presets.desc: Drift plus a downward rain-sheet drift, cool desaturation and heavy static grain.

presets.label: Embers
presets.desc: Warm flickering brightness pulse over a slow lateral drift — firelight on stone.

presets.label: Rooftop
presets.desc: Vertical parallax with a slow pull-back, like leaning over a night highway.

presets.label: Vigil
presets.desc: Almost still: a barely-there zoom with a soft vignette, so the visualizer carries the motion.
